ruleDefinitions.name: Process Memory Dump Via Comsvcs.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a process memory dump via "comsvcs.dll" using rundll32, covering multiple different techniques (ordinal, minidump function, etc.)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*")) AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*comsvcs.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*full.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#\\+.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#24.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*24\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MiniDump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#65560.*"))))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*24.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*comsvcs.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*full.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\#.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\,\\#.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\,\\ \\#.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\"\\#.*")))
